metadata.description: The plugin catalogue LibraOS Next installs from.

plugins.name: redact
plugins.description: Replaces names, organizations, places, contact details, ID numbers, credentials and dates in a message and its attachments with placeholders before it is sent; Word documents and PDFs with a text layer go as redacted text. Runs on your own computer; you review the change before it goes. Needs Python 3.10+ and about 2 GB for its model. Works in LibraOS Next only: it is a before-send hook, which Claude Code itself does not run.
